India's Industrial Output Growth Decelerates in July

India's Index of Industrial Production (IIP) grew by 6.7% in July, a slowdown from the 8.8% recorded in June. The deceleration was attributed to weaker performance in the manufacturing and mining sectors. The previous month's growth figure was also revised from 7.3% to 8.8%.
